bds.h: Trump signs proclamation he says will prevent future changes to the Oval Office and Cabinet Room
bds.lede: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday signed a proclamation that he said will prevent future changes to the Oval Office and Cabinet Room as he has redesigned them.
rows: CTV News
U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday signed a proclamation that he said will prevent future changes to the Oval Office and Cabinet Room as he has redesigned them.
ABC News
Trump indicated the proclamation would have to be ratified by Congress.
BBC News
The order comes after Trump made a series of big changes to the decor of the Oval Office and tore down the White House East Wing.
CBS News

The action does not prevent future presidents from restyling the iconic office that President Trump has filled to the brim with gold flourishes, nor does it prevent a successor from rolling back the proclamation itself.
CBC News
U.S. President Donald Trump signed a proclamation Thursday declaring the Oval Office and Cabinet room of the White House to be national monuments.
PBS NewsHour
It was the third day this week that the president, a real estate mogul, delivered remarks fixated on his pet projects in Washington.
